thread:
nora: Quick sync - planning to switch metering emit to upstream resolver so `route_resolution_id` is stamped at emit time. Main concern: preview UI and per-route quota cards may see transient holes during session migrations.

liam: I like stamping earlier for routing accuracy, but we need to handle clients still shipping `route_id`. Suggest edge translate + annotate events with `x-route-origin`.

parul: UX ask: can we surface a "preview source" indicator in the quota card (legacy vs resolved) so support can reproduce differences quickly? Also add an audit column to invoice-preview listing origin.

ops-bot: rollout-status: feature-flag gated, shadowing enabled for 24h on canary cluster at 1726005000.

liam: telemetry: emit these metrics ASAP: `meter.emit.count`, `meter.emit.lag_ms.p50|p95`, `route.resolve.miss_rate`. Dash: compare tenant token totals (legacy agg vs resolved agg) and surface median delta.

nora: Implementation detail: to avoid double writes while both systems run, I propose we write only to the new path for canary tenants, and emit a tombstone header `x-old-write-suppressed: true` to help the ledger dedupe. Ledger side should use `dedupe_key = tenant_id|event_id|route_resolution_id`.

parul: Can we avoid changing invoice IDs? Last migration caused invoice preview churn because invoice line hashes changed. We should keep line hashing stable by ordering keys the same and using canonical JSON before hashing.

liam: Agree. Also watch rounding: aggregation cutoff and token bucket logic must be identical. Add a unit test that replays identical messages through old and new flow and asserts identical invoice line hashes.

nora: For preview stability during shadow, we will backfill a pre-join cache: when resolver resolves a new route, also record fallback mapping old_route->new_resolution for 48h. Preview reads prefer resolution but fall back. We'll emit a `meter.preview.fallback_hit` counter when fallback used.

parul: Dashboard/alerts: create alert when median tenant delta > 0.3% for 30m or when `route.resolve.miss_rate` > 0.01. Add a small UI toggle: "Use resolved routes" for preview mode so SEs can flip between sources.

liam: Edge change: convert incoming `route_id` to `route_resolution_id` using resolver cache. If cache miss, annotate `x-route-origin: unresolved` and let enrich pipeline attempt async resolution. This will surface in `route.resolve.miss_rate`.

nora: To guard duplicates: ledger ingest will ignore any event where `duplicate_guard_hits` metric triggers (we'll set window=90s). Also, when we do canary writes, only one writer per event_id is allowed. The canary writer will set `x-writer-tag: canary-v1`.

ops-bot: canary-deploy: new-resolver integrated into edge proxy at 1726005200. Shadow writes started 1726005300 for tenant-sample=canary-group-42.

parul: Checklist for Friday cutover:
- Feature flag flips + canary to 10% if shadow is green
- Add preview toggle & invoice audit column
- Dashboards: tenant-delta panel, resolve-miss heatmap, duplicate_guard graph
- Docs: API changelog + migration note for clientlibs (explain `x-route-origin`)
- Run integration replay test that asserts line-hash parity within 0.05% tokens

liam: I'll own the edge translation + resolver cache TTL tuning. Plan: 30s TTL, 5k-entry LRU, metrics on evictions.

nora: I'll own runbook and rollback. Rollback if >0.5% median delta sustained for 1h or if duplicate_guard hits spike above threshold.

parul: Heads up for billing: notify CS so they can expect a few preview differences during canary. Add a note to the console help text describing the preview-source toggle.

build-bot: build status: integration replay tests queued; job id 98543.

nora: final items: link the runbook here once ready and paste the canary dashboard URL. I'll kick off the 24h shadow tonight at 22:00 UTC. :rocket:

liam: thanks — ping if any invoice blips.

parul: adding a minor UX ask: highlight changed lines in invoice-preview diff view (green/red) so support can triage quicker.

nora: noted. Closing plan for now.
